timeout_scope: whole child process: input, preprocessing, initialization, SGD, stress evaluation and output
measurement_policy: sequential; one warmup per graph/method/pivots/tile setting; successful runs only; failed warmup blocks formal seeds with explicit unexecuted records
rationale: Keep v3 resource monitoring unchanged; rerun only Sparse graphs shown in paper figures. Basic runs have no trace instrumentation; convergence traces are separate.
artifact_policy: Buffered native text exports; after the child exits, text and f64 checkpoints are losslessly gzip level1 archived with CRC and SHA verification outside native timing. Initial interrupted 662 conditions excluded.
